mapper.select: SELECT profile.company_id, profile.roles, profile.interest_areas, profile.introduction, profile.capabilities, profile.created_at, profile.updated_at FROM company_partner_profile profile WHERE profile.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_partner_profile ( company_id, roles, interest_areas, introduction, capabilities, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{rolesJson}, #{interestAreasJson}, #{introduction}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE roles = VALUES(roles), interest_areas = VALUES(interest_areas), introduction = VALUES(introduction), capabilities = VALUES(capabilities), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
